sources.title: Measles: Death toll reaches 1,222 as 8 more children die in 24hrs

quotes.text: The health directorate recorded the deaths of eight children with measles-like symptoms in the 24 hours preceding 8am today (24 October), taking Bangladesh's combined toll of confirmed and suspected measles-related deaths to 1,222.
On 4 April 2026, the National IHR Focal Point of Bangladesh notified WHO of a significant increase in measles cases, driven by sustained domestic transmission.

sources.title: 8 more children die of measles-like symptoms

quotes.text: Eight people died of measles-like symptoms in the past 24 hours, bringing the total number of such deaths to 1,118 from March 15 to October 24.

sources.title: UK court freezes £15m London apartment of ex-land minister’s brother

quotes.text: UK High Court has frozen a £15 million London apartment linked to Anisuzzaman Chowdhury Ronny, brother of Bangladesh’s former land minister Saifuzzaman Chowdhury Javed, after anti-corruption investigators alleged that the property was connected to embezzlement, corruption, fraud and money laundering, reports the Financial Times.
Justice Karen Steyn ruled that there was a good arguable case that the property represented the proceeds of crime and granted the freezing order.
Speaking to the FT, he said he had decided, on legal advice, not to contest the NCA’s application but denied any unlawful conduct.

sources.title: Ex-minister Saifuzzaman, others face cases over Tk 141cr embezzlement

quotes.text: The Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) has approved the filing of three separate cases over the alleged embezzlement and laundering of Tk 141.2 crore from Islami Bank Bangladesh PLC’s Jubilee Road branch in Chattogram, involving Aramit Cement PLC.
